test_exercises_changed_path.instructions: At least one test in the diff actually exercises the changed code path.

criteria.true: a test drives the changed runtime code path
criteria.false: no test drives the changed runtime code path

accompanying_test_asserts_behavior.instructions: At least one accompanying test asserts the changed behavior (not assertTrue(true), not unrelated).

criteria.true: an assertion checks the changed behavior
criteria.false: no assertion checks the changed behavior

all_tests_vacuous.instructions: EVERY accompanying test's assertions are vacuous or unrelated (collectively a no-op).

criteria.false: at least one accompanying assertion is meaningful

case_coverage.instructions: Rate coverage of the obvious case types for the changed behavior.
